Game Overview

Obby the Pets Manager puts players into a casual experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Obby the Pets Manager doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Obby the Pets Manager?

Obby the Pets Manager is a free casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Obby the Pets Manager free to play?

Yes, Obby the Pets Manager is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
